description: Formal specifications of CrossLLM mutation operators across 6 security property families for the 12 evaluation lineages.

operators.name: Cross-Chain Message Nonce & Delivery Tracking Omission
operators.precondition: The destination endpoint or bridge records a message hash, sequence number, or nonce to prevent replay.
operators.transformation: Remove the storage update or state check marking the message or delivery hash as executed.
operators.semantic_consequence: The exact same valid cross-chain message can be submitted and processed multiple times on the destination chain.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_REPLAY_UNIQUENESS: Every cross-chain message identifier shall be executed at most once on destination domain.
operators.negative_control_policy: Reinstate idempotent execution check and assert double-execution reverts with 'AlreadyExecuted' or equivalent.

operators.name: Domain Separator Scope Stripping
operators.precondition: The message commitment or hash includes source chainId or destination domain identifier.
operators.transformation: Omit the domain/chainId parameter from the message digest calculation.
operators.semantic_consequence: A valid message dispatched for Chain A can be validly relayed and consumed on Chain B.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_DOMAIN_ISOLATION: Message proofs and signatures must be strictly bound to the target destination chain ID.
operators.negative_control_policy: Enforce destination domain binding in message hash verification.

operators.name: Unauthenticated Source Sender Spoofing
operators.precondition: The message payload carries source caller/sender address which the receiver callback uses for access control.
operators.transformation: Bypass validation comparing message origin to expected cross-chain counterpart or authorized peer.
operators.semantic_consequence: An arbitrary sender on the source domain can trigger privileged receiver logic on the destination domain.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_SOURCE_AUTH: Destination execution must authenticate that the source message originator equals the authorized remote peer.
operators.negative_control_policy: Strictly check msg.sender == authorizedSourceAddress or verify trusted peer mapping.

operators.name: Forged Source Chain Identifier Acceptance
operators.precondition: The protocol validates that the incoming message was dispatched from a supported source domain.
operators.transformation: Weaken source chain ID validation, accepting zero or wildcard source domain identifiers.
operators.semantic_consequence: Attacker can present messages with forged or unconfigured chain identifiers, bypassing routing security modules.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_ROUTING_VALIDITY: Incoming cross-chain packets must strictly match an admitted, active network domain.
operators.negative_control_policy: Enforce registered domain checks before dispatching payload to destination handlers.

operators.name: Cross-Chain Asset Conservation and Fee Underflow
operators.precondition: The bridge deducts protocol/relayer fees from the deposited token amount before release or minting.
operators.transformation: Invert fee subtraction to addition or omit amount balance consistency checks during destination mint/unlock.
operators.semantic_consequence: Destination domain mints or unlocks more tokens than were locked on source chain, violating total cross-chain conservation.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_VALUE_CONSERVATION: Total destination released amount plus fees cannot exceed total source deposited amount.
operators.negative_control_policy: Enforce strict balance deltas: destination_released + fees == source_locked.

operators.name: Liquidity Pool & Share Accounting Desynchronization
operators.precondition: The protocol updates local pool liquidity records when fulfilling cross-chain transfer requests.
operators.transformation: Skip debiting local liquidity reserves upon transfer fill, while continuing to transfer tokens to recipient.
operators.semantic_consequence: Internal accounting reserves desynchronize with actual ERC20 balances, leading to insolvent pool states.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_POOL_SOLVENCY: Internal ledger accounting must strictly reflect actual physical token reserves.
operators.negative_control_policy: Update pool balances atomically with external token transfers.

operators.name: Receiver Endpoint Authorization Bypass
operators.precondition: The application contract exposes a callback (e.g. handle, receiveMessage) protected by onlyBridge / onlyMailbox.
operators.transformation: Remove or comment out the caller authorization modifier on the receive callback.
operators.semantic_consequence: Direct unprivileged calls on the destination chain can spoof cross-chain message execution without any bridge verification.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_ENTRYPOINT_PRIVILEGE: Cross-chain callback functions may only be invoked by the verified protocol bridge/endpoint.
operators.negative_control_policy: Enforce require(msg.sender == address(trustedBridge)) on all cross-domain receiver methods.

operators.name: Cross-Chain Message Delivery State Reentrancy
operators.precondition: The bridge executes an arbitrary receiver call before finalizing delivery state.
operators.transformation: Move internal state updates (such as message completion flags) after external message execution call.
operators.semantic_consequence: Malicious receiver contract can reenter bridge execute function before message status is recorded as executed.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_CHECKS_EFFECTS_INTERACTIONS: Cross-chain bridge must transition internal delivery state before invoking external contract hooks.
operators.negative_control_policy: Apply CEI pattern and NonReentrant guard around cross-chain message dispatches.

operators.name: Multi-Attestation Quorum Threshold Bypass
operators.precondition: A threshold of relayer/validator signatures is required to approve cross-domain execution.
operators.transformation: Reduce the required signature threshold calculation (e.g. threshold = 1 or threshold = 0) or accept repeated signatures from same validator.
operators.semantic_consequence: A sub-threshold number of compromised or forged validator signatures can execute arbitrary cross-chain operations.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_QUORUM_THRESHOLD: Message execution requires strict adherence to M-of-N distinct validator signatures.
operators.negative_control_policy: Require distinct valid signer addresses matching active validator set >= required quorum.

operators.name: Optimistic Challenge Window & Dispute Bypass
operators.precondition: An optimistic bridge enforces a challenge period (dispute window) before withdrawal or root finalization.
operators.transformation: Set challenge window period to zero or omit timestamp check against block.timestamp.
operators.semantic_consequence: Fraudulent roots or withdrawals can be finalized immediately without allowing honest observers time to submit fraud proofs.
operators.intended_security_property: PROP_FINALITY_DELAY: State root or withdrawal finalization must enforce elapsed time >= CHALLENGE_PERIOD.
operators.negative_control_policy: Require require(block.timestamp >= proposalTimestamp + challengePeriod) prior to execution.
